direct_human_oracle_judgments.limitations: Four human-oracle scenario templates per condition, not an independent broad benchmark. Other12cases use reviewed exact strip-only oracles. Synthetic fixture assistant turns are supplied context, not generated history. Bare-context ablation changes/removes style instruction; only semantic/exact task recovery is compared. This does not identify a training root cause, prove arbitrary family-level decontamination, or alter prior5/100.
